dedupe_keys.name: supplementary files for open access nationwide data sets for drinking water hardness at public waterworks and their water supply areas in denmark

description: GEUS publishes three Danish drinking-water hardness series: waterworks observations for 1905-2023, supply-area annual values for 1978-2023, and latest supply-area values for 1980-2023. The authors derive hardness from quality-checked Jupiter observations, aggregate them and fill gaps. This resource is provided by Voutchkova, Denitza D; Thomsen, Charlotte T; Claes, Niels and coauthors. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists application/dbf, application/octet-stream, application/prj, application/shp, application/shx formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence terms are linked in the provider metadata and require reading before reuse. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Outlier removal and gap filling affect interpretation. The nationwide data product is broader than a single local instance. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
